## Description and Rationale

I’m a Computer Science & Engineering student at TU Delft with a strong interest in machine learning, data analysis, and algorithms. I joined the PRC Data Challenge to apply what I’ve learned to a real-world aviation problem, challenge myself, and see what I can build with data-driven methods.
